head: Rank

Luck Reading:
Temporarily increases the growth rate (50%) of a selected social stat.

Money Reading:
Temporarily increases money earned from battle.

Affinity Reading:
Deepens your bond (+5 points) with a Confidant of your choice.

Special Fate Reading:
Provides a preview of all abilities for a Confidant of your choice.

Celestial Reading:
Increases the chances of fusion alarms occurring in the Velvet Room.

Special Bond Reading:
Displays the responses that grant the highest confidant points during Confidant events.
